question: Get details of repositories that use specific feature toggle libraries. For each repository, include the full name with owner, hosting platform type, size in bytes, primary programming language, fork source name (if any), last update timestamp, the artifact and library names of the feature toggle used, and the library's programming languages. Include repositories that depend on the specified feature toggle libraries, defined by their artifact names, library names, platforms, and languages.
sql:
WITH feature_toggle_libs AS (
  SELECT 'Unleash.FeatureToggle.Client' AS artifact_name, 'NuGet' AS platform, 'unleash-client-dotnet' AS library_name, 'C#, Visual Basic' AS languages
  UNION ALL SELECT 'unleash.client', 'NuGet', 'unleash-client', 'C#, Visual Basic'
  UNION ALL SELECT 'LaunchDarkly.Client', 'NuGet', 'launchdarkly', 'C#, Visual Basic'
  UNION ALL SELECT 'NFeature', 'NuGet', 'NFeature', 'C#, Visual Basic'
  UNION ALL SELECT 'FeatureToggle', 'NuGet', 'FeatureToggle', 'C#, Visual Basic'
  UNION ALL SELECT 'FeatureSwitcher', 'NuGet', 'FeatureSwitcher', 'C#, Visual Basic'
  UNION ALL SELECT 'Toggler', 'NuGet', 'Toggler', 'C#, Visual Basic'
  UNION ALL SELECT 'github.com/launchdarkly/go-client', 'Go', 'launchdarkly', 'Go'
  UNION ALL SELECT 'github.com/xchapter7x/toggle', 'Go', 'Toggle', 'Go'
  UNION ALL SELECT 'github.com/vsco/dcdr', 'Go', 'dcdr', 'Go'
  UNION ALL SELECT 'github.com/unleash/unleash-client-go', 'Go', 'unleash-client-go', 'Go'
  UNION ALL SELECT 'unleash-client', 'NPM', 'unleash-client-node', 'JavaScript, TypeScript'
  UNION ALL SELECT 'ldclient-js', 'NPM', 'launchdarkly', 'JavaScript, TypeScript'
  UNION ALL SELECT 'ember-feature-flags', 'NPM', 'ember-feature-flags', 'JavaScript, TypeScript'
  UNION ALL SELECT 'feature-toggles', 'NPM', 'feature-toggles', 'JavaScript, TypeScript'
  UNION ALL SELECT '@paralleldrive/react-feature-toggles', 'NPM', 'React Feature Toggles', 'JavaScript, TypeScript'
  UNION ALL SELECT 'ldclient-node', 'NPM', 'launchdarkly', 'JavaScript, TypeScript'
  UNION ALL SELECT 'flipit', 'NPM', 'flipit', 'JavaScript, TypeScript'
  UNION ALL SELECT 'fflip', 'NPM', 'fflip', 'JavaScript, TypeScript'
  UNION ALL SELECT 'bandiera-client', 'NPM', 'Bandiera', 'JavaScript, TypeScript'
  UNION ALL SELECT '@flopflip/react-redux', 'NPM', 'flopflip', 'JavaScript, TypeScript'
  UNION ALL SELECT '@flopflip/react-broadcast', 'NPM', 'flopflip', 'JavaScript, TypeScript'
  UNION ALL SELECT 'com.launchdarkly:launchdarkly-android-client', 'Maven', 'launchdarkly', 'Kotlin, Java'
  UNION ALL SELECT 'cc.soham:toggle', 'Maven', 'toggle', 'Kotlin, Java'
  UNION ALL SELECT 'no.finn.unleash:unleash-client-java', 'Maven', 'unleash-client-java', 'Kotlin, Java'
  UNION ALL SELECT 'com.launchdarkly:launchdarkly-client', 'Maven', 'launchdarkly', 'Kotlin, Java'
  UNION ALL SELECT 'org.togglz:togglz-core', 'Maven', 'Togglz', 'Kotlin, Java'
  UNION ALL SELECT 'org.ff4j:ff4j-core', 'Maven', 'FF4J', 'Kotlin, Java'
  UNION ALL SELECT 'com.tacitknowledge.flip:core', 'Maven', 'Flip', 'Kotlin, Java'
  UNION ALL SELECT 'LaunchDarkly', 'CocoaPods', 'launchdarkly', 'Objective-C, Swift'
  UNION ALL SELECT 'launchdarkly/ios-client', 'Carthage', 'launchdarkly', 'Objective-C, Swift'
  UNION ALL SELECT 'launchdarkly/launchdarkly-php', 'Packagist', 'launchdarkly', 'PHP'
  UNION ALL SELECT 'dzunke/feature-flags-bundle', 'Packagist', 'Symfony FeatureFlagsBundle', 'PHP'
  UNION ALL SELECT 'opensoft/rollout', 'Packagist', 'rollout', 'PHP'
  UNION ALL SELECT 'npg/bandiera-client-php', 'Packagist', 'Bandiera', 'PHP'
  UNION ALL SELECT 'UnleashClient', 'Pypi', 'unleash-client-python', 'Python'
  UNION ALL SELECT 'ldclient-py', 'Pypi', 'launchdarkly', 'Python'
  UNION ALL SELECT 'Flask-FeatureFlags', 'Pypi', 'Flask FeatureFlags', 'Python'
  UNION ALL SELECT 'gutter', 'Pypi', 'Gutter', 'Python'
  UNION ALL SELECT 'feature_ramp', 'Pypi', 'Feature Ramp', 'Python'
  UNION ALL SELECT 'flagon', 'Pypi', 'flagon', 'Python'
  UNION ALL SELECT 'django-waffle', 'Pypi', 'Waffle', 'Python'
  UNION ALL SELECT 'gargoyle', 'Pypi', 'Gargoyle', 'Python'
  UNION ALL SELECT 'gargoyle-yplan', 'Pypi', 'Gargoyle', 'Python'
  UNION ALL SELECT 'unleash', 'Rubygems', 'unleash-client-ruby', 'Ruby'
  UNION ALL SELECT 'ldclient-rb', 'Rubygems', 'launchdarkly', 'Ruby'
  UNION ALL SELECT 'rollout', 'Rubygems', 'rollout', 'Ruby'
  UNION ALL SELECT 'feature_flipper', 'Rubygems', 'FeatureFlipper', 'Ruby'
  UNION ALL SELECT 'flip', 'Rubygems', 'Flip', 'Ruby'
  UNION ALL SELECT 'setler', 'Rubygems', 'Setler', 'Ruby'
  UNION ALL SELECT 'bandiera-client', 'Rubygems', 'Bandiera', 'Ruby'
  UNION ALL SELECT 'feature', 'Rubygems', 'Feature', 'Ruby'
  UNION ALL SELECT 'flipper', 'Rubygems', 'Flipper', 'Ruby'
  UNION ALL SELECT 'com.springernature:bandiera-client-scala_2.12', 'Maven', 'Bandiera', 'Scala'
  UNION ALL SELECT 'com.springernature:bandiera-client-scala_2.11', 'Maven', 'Bandiera', 'Scala'
),
matching_deps AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT d.project_id, ft.artifact_name, ft.library_name, ft.languages
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.libraries_io.dependencies` d
  JOIN feature_toggle_libs ft ON d.dependency_name = ft.artifact_name AND d.dependency_platform = ft.platform
)
SELECT 
  pwr.repository_name_with_owner,
  pwr.repository_host_type AS platform,
  pwr.repository_size * 1024 AS size_in_bytes,
  pwr.repository_language AS primary_language,
  pwr.repository_fork_source_name_with_owner,
  pwr.repository_updated_timestamp AS last_update_timestamp,
  md.artifact_name,
  md.library_name,
  md.languages AS library_languages
FROM matching_deps md
JOIN `bigquery-public-data.libraries_io.projects` p ON md.project_id = p.id
JOIN `bigquery-public-data.libraries_io.projects_with_repository_fields` pwr ON p.id = pwr.id
WHERE pwr.repository_name_with_owner IS NOT NULL
